newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo Wellcome bullish on lamvudine trials.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo Wellcome bullish on lamvudine trials.

text.p: Glaxo Wellcome said on Thursday that the results of Phase III trials on the lamvudine drug with regard to chronically affected hepatitis B patients was "extremely encouraging".
Lamivudine is a nucleoside analogue anti-viral drug for the treatment of hepatitis B, which is under development by Glaxo Wellcome.

The company's share price rose 20 pence to 1108-1/2 p after it made the announcement. Glaxo is due to present the studies in London later in the day at the annual meeting of the European Association for the study of the liver.
